4009150.name: Hawk Claw

4009152.name: Hunting Dog's Fang
4009152.desc: A fang from the grave robber's hunting dogs. Seems sharp enough to pierce anything.

4009153.name: Neon Bat Wings

4009154.name: Glowing Primary Rock Fragment

4009155.name: Spirit Substance

4009156.name: Darkness Fragment

4009157.name: Omen's Fragment
4009157.desc: You feel the same mysterious energy in this that you felt from the Omen.

4009158.name: Master Omen's Fragment
4009158.desc: You feel the same mysterious energy in this that you felt from the Master Omen.

4009159.name: Demolisher Part
4009159.desc: A part from the Barrier Demolisher.

4009160.name: Surveillance Robot Memory Chip
4009160.desc: This memory chip is all that's left of a Surveillance Robot.

4009169.name: Frozen Rose Petal
4009169.desc: A rose petal frozen from centuries in the snow. Doesn't seem tasty, so you might as well sell it at the shop.

4009170.name: Loose Chain

4009171.name: Dried Rose Vine

4009172.name: Shiny Flower Powder

4009173.name: Suspicious Lime Powder

4009174.name: Apple

4009175.name: Grapes

4009177.name: Weird thing

4009178.name: Something weird
4009178.desc: Sonia said it's proof that I shouldn't believe Gilbert.

4009179.name: His Trace

4009181.name: Talisman
4009181.desc: The Wisdom Statue said it would help defeate Vale. Not sure.

4009192.name: Treasure Chest Key

4009194.name: Blood Pirate Emblem

4009195.name: Siren's Talon
4009195.desc: Claws left behind by a Siren. Very sharp.

4009220.name: Spotted Wings
4009220.desc: These are the wings of a ladybug. They make good meals for baby foxes.

4009221.name: Sparrow Egg
4009221.desc: An egg stolen from a sparrow's nest. It makes a delicious treat for foxes.

4009222.name: Mouse Tail
4009222.desc: A tail from a Balloon Mouse. It's a yummy fox treat.

4009223.name: Red Frog Legs
4009223.desc: Frog legs from a Red Poison Frog. Be careful, they're poisonous all over.

4009224.name: Green Frog Legs
4009224.desc: Frog legs from a Green Poison Frog. Be careful, it's poisonous all over.

4009225.name: Mohawk Feather
4009225.desc: A fuzzy feather from a Delinquent Chick. It's covered in rebellious hair wax.

4009226.name: Rocker Feather
4009226.desc: A fuzzy feather from a Punk Chick. It's covered in hard rock hair wax.

4009227.name: Mane Fur
4009227.desc: Fur from a hyena's back. Nice spots.

4009228.name: Fang
4009228.desc: A long fang from a hyena. It symbolizes bravery, because someone had to go in there to get it.

4009229.name: Rock-Paper-Scissors Ticket
4009229.desc: This sloppy Rock-Paper-Scissors Ticket says #c'teeket'#. Lil Zakum needs some spelling lessons.

4009230.name: Ancient Evil Eye Tail
4009230.desc: A tail of an Evil Eye that used to live in the Ancient Cave. It's glossy and lustrous, unlike the tails of those other loser Evil Eyes.

4009231.name: Clockwise Labyrinth Key
4009231.desc: Drop it on the portal in the room to rotate the room's destination once clockwise.

4009232.name: Red Sand Powder
4009232.desc: Red Sand Powder dropped by a Red Sand Dwarf. Used to explore the 29th floor of the Tower of Oz. If you gather 10 Red Sand Powders, a Red Sand Crystal will appear beneath a tree on the left.

4009233.name: Counterclockwise Labyrinth Key
4009233.desc: Drop it on the portal in the room to rotate the room's destination once counterclockwise.

4009234.name: Yellow Leather
4009234.desc: A piece of yellow leather dropped by a Yellow Curly Cow. It's thin and light and doesn't tear easily. It would be great for clothing, but you have to use it to open the portal.

4009235.name: Purple Leather
4009235.desc: A piece of purple leather dropped by a Purple Curly Cow. It's a bit thick, but still looks luxurious. Get enough to escape the floor.

4009236.name: Orange Slime Liquid
4009236.desc: A substance from an Orange Ancient Slime. Gather 10 of this stuff and drop them on the Burning Altar to summon an Orange Ancient Slime.

4009237.name: Ancient Blue Turtle Egg
4009237.desc: An Ancient Blue Turtle's egg. Would make quite an omelet.

4009238.name: Ancient Orange Turtle Egg
4009238.desc: An Ancient Orange Turtle's egg. Would make quite a breakfast.

4009239.name: Gold Richie Figure

4009240.name: Gold Richie Figure
4009240.desc: A really cheesy figurine of Gold Richie, but you need it for the Gold Richie's Safe Event.

4009261.display_name: 検出されたナノウェーブ

4009266.name: Skeledog's Bone
4009266.desc: A mysterious bone. You might be able to make a spicy soup with this bone.\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid, go ahead!

4009267.name: The Key
4009267.desc: It's a Heart Key which allows you to open the hearts of people who are eating lunch. You could use it to have people change their mind.\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

4009268.name: Dinoram Tenderloin
4009268.desc: A thick meat loaf. It looks delicious.\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

4009269.name: Tough Dragon Skin
4009269.desc: Very tough monster meat. It's really hard to chew and it tastes like squid.\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

4009270.name: Balrog's Seal Stone
4009270.desc: An Evil Spirit Seal Stone. Am I getting controlled by this stone?\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

4009271.name: Poisonous Mushroom
4009271.desc: A colorful mushroom. Let's hope it's not poisonous\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

4009272.name: Leaf
4009272.desc: It's very fresh, just fresh.\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

4009273.name: Evil Eye Tail
4009273.desc: A monster's tentacle. It looks disgusting, but some say it's pretty delicious.\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

4009274.name: Free Spirit
4009274.desc: The soul of a bear. This food will literally have 'soul' if you cook with this.r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

4009275.name: Chicken Leg
4009275.desc: A chicken Leg from Von Bon. It's pretty big.\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

4009277.name: Ticket
4009277.desc: It's a Wood Theme Park Ticket. Deliver it to Penya.

4009278.name: Fake Ticket
4009278.desc: It's a paper that looks like a Wood Theme Park Ticket. The quality is too bad to use as a ticket.

4009279.name: Tears of Time
4009279.desc: Element earned from mirror world.  You get power by bringing it to the 'Sanctun of Time' then praying

4009280.name: Hermes Cube Fragment

4009281.desc: Nothing can resist the itch this nasty stuff causes. Use it to see how a Mushroom House reacts.

4009297.desc: A unique liquid only found in marine organisms around the deserted island. Excellent for waterproofing, but smells... wrong.

4009298.name: Fuel Mixture
4009298.desc: A strange fuel found all over the deserted island. Can be made even stranger and more efficient by combining with other components.

4009299.name: Repair Screw
4009299.desc: You can fix all kinds of mechanical devices with this. Everything needs screws!

4009300.name: Repair Cord
4009300.desc: You can fix all kinds of electronic devices with this. Can't have too much cord!

4009301.name: Repair Plate
4009301.desc: You can reinforce things with this. Handy for things that take a beating.

4009302.name: Lost Entry

4009303.name: Lost Records

4030036.name: Rose Seed

4030038.name: Bizarre Dust Ball

4036104.name: Aspire Visitor's ID
4036104.desc: A visitor ID Badge that allows you to enter the headquarters of Aspire Industries, creators of the #cWondroid#.

4036105.name: Accursed Horn Energy
4036105.desc: Residue from the horns of Magnus. Collect several to remove Kaiserium's Curse.

4036106.name: Rainbow Dew
4036106.desc: A brilliant Rainbow Dew eaten by Orange Mushroom.\r\nYou can drag it to feed Orange Mushroom.

4036107.name: Model 13's Key
4036107.desc: A key held by Guardroid Model 13 at #cAspire#.

4036108.name: Model 6's Key
4036108.desc: A key held by Guardroid Model 6 at #cAspire#.

4036109.name: Model 82's Key
4036109.desc: A key held by Guardroid Model 82 at #cAspire#.

4036110.name: Work Order
4036110.desc: A work order used for work on the #cWondroid# project at #cAspire Industries#.

4036111.name: Wondroid Research Diary
4036111.desc: A research diary detailing the entire creation and development of the #cWondroid# at #cAspire Industries#.\r\n#c[Classified TOP SECRET]\r\nClearance Level 3#

4036112.name: Rune-Engraved Elunite Crystal
4036112.desc: An Elunite Crystal engraved with alien runes. It feels unlike any other Elunite Crystal you've discovered.

4036113.name: Churmble Specimen
4036113.desc: A research sample harvested from the crystal-coated Eluna lifeform known as a 'Churmble.'

4036114.name: Thalia Floatyfish Specimen
4036114.desc: A research sample from the 'Thalia Floatyfish.' It looks more like a monster than a plant.

4036115.name: Deadly Biteysnek Specimen
4036115.desc: A research sample from the 'Deadly Biteysnek'. It appears to be capable of asexual reproduction at a cellular level, explaining the lifeform's abundance on this planet. Smells like chicken.

4036116.name: Captured Churmble
4036116.desc: Churmble that has been successfully captured and placed in a cage. You feel kind of bad, but science requires sacrifice.

4036117.name: Captured Atlassian Crab
4036117.desc: Atlas that has been successfully captured and put in a cage. That's no drab little crab. It's as shiny as they come.

4036118.name: Spaceflight Research Laboratory Photo
4036118.desc: A photo of a ruined facility that appears to have once been used to research spaceflight.

4036119.name: Photo of Water Filtration Facility Ruins
4036119.desc: A photo of a ruined facility that appears to have once been used to extract and purify water.
4036119.display_name: Photo of Water Filtration Facility Ruins

4036120.name: Sub-Zero Hunt EXP Boost
4036120.desc: You gain a powerful EXP buff when you hunt monsters in the Sub-Zero Hunt.

4036121.name: Dark Residue
4036121.desc: It's a dark residue commonly obtained from the monsters found at Gold Beach.

4036122.name: Old Bone Fragment
4036122.desc: It's an old bone fragment that can be obtained from monsters at the Excavation Site. Despite its shabby appearance, it has great archaeological value.

4036123.name: Drake Tissue Sample
4036123.desc: It's a tissue harvested from a Drake. Apparently it's quite valuable for biological research.

4036124.name: Artificial Organism Tissue Sample
4036124.desc: It's a tissue sample from an artificial organism created by way of alchemy. It could be quite valuable for study.

4036125.name: Mechanical Lifeform Component
4036125.desc: A component from a mechanical lifeform. It appears to have been crafted through the synergy of alchemy and engineering.

4036126.name: Horntail's Evil Energy
4036126.desc: It's an energy commonly found from monsters in Minar Forest influenced by Horntail. How you managed to collect it, only the developers can answer.

4036127.name: Empty Ryuul Data Disk
4036127.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology. It's calibrated to interface with the data collector in the Swamp Region.

4036128.name: Photo of Stellar Observatory Ruins
4036128.desc: A photo of a ruined structure that appears to have once been used to study the stars.

4036129.name: Full Ryuul Data Disk
4036129.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  It's filled with data from the Swamp Region.

4036130.name: Empty Ryuul Data Disk
4036130.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  Use it to collect data on Drake monsters.

4036131.name: Full Ryuul Data Disk
4036131.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  It's filled with data on Drake monsters.

4036132.name: Lidium Sample
4036132.desc: It's the Lidium ore that Eremos asked you to obtain.

4036133.name: Ryuul Mobile Data Collector
4036133.desc: It's a Ryuul data storage device that's been jury-rigged into a mobile data collector. You can use it to record data on the enemies you fight in Ellin Forest.\r\n\r\nApparently it's powered by a micro-singularity, so unless you're looking to destroy two versions of Maple World at once, maybe don't break it.

4036134.name: Zakum Fragment Sample
4036134.desc: It's a fragment of Zakum's statue you collected for Eremos. He seemed eager to analyze it.

4036135.name: Empty Ryuul Data Disk
4036135.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  Use it to collect data on the Minar Forest region.

4036136.name: Full Ryuul Data Disk
4036136.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  It's filled with data on the Minar Forest region.

4036137.name: Dry Firewood
4036137.desc: Dry firewood that Volcano Bugs love. It has Volcano Bug droppings on it but still burns okay.

4036138.name: Resin
4036138.desc: Resin that Beetles love. Beetles tend to have mouths sticky with resin.

4036139.name: Mountain Turtle Egg
4036139.desc: The egg of a Mountain Turtle. Don't eat it raw or you'll get a tummy ache!

4036140.name: Cast Iron Plate
4036140.desc: A cast iron plate that used to be part of a Hedgehog's body. It's slightly rusted.

4036141.name: Big Nail
4036141.desc: A big nail that used to be stuck on a Mutant Hedgehog's body. It's slightly rusted.

4036142.name: Mutant Hedgehog Fur
4036142.desc: Mutant Hedgehog fur, hidden beneath cast iron plates and big nails.

4036143.name: Nutria Hind Leg
4036143.desc: The hind leg of a Nutria. Melts in your mouth!

4036144.name: Still Fluid
4036144.desc: Fluid from inside a waste drum. Strangely, it doesn't flow.

4036145.name: Unburning Flame
4036145.desc: A flame found inside a waste drum. Strangely, it doesn't burn.

4036146.name: Soft Scrap Iron
4036146.desc: A heap of scrap metal from inside a waste drum. Strangely, it's soft and malleable.

4036147.name: Wiggling Tail
4036147.desc: The wiggling tail of a Specter Stray Dog. It almost seems alive.

4036150.name: Mutant Hedgehog Fur Tuft
4036150.desc: A tuft of fur. You should take it to Coney.

4036151.name: Mutant Nutria Blood
4036151.desc: The blood of a Mutant Nutria. You get the feeling you shouldn't touch it with your bare hands..

4036152.name: Poison Remover
4036152.desc: Used by Mr. Hazard's men to clean their hideout.

4036153.name: Onyx Stonegar Magic Stone
4036153.desc: A stone that absorbs magical energy from Onyx Stonegar.

4036154.name: Decent Wooden Shield
4036154.desc: A wooden shield used by a Specter Shieldbearer. It's fairly big and sturdy.

4036156.name: Yellow Speeyor Fur Coat
4036156.desc: Yellow Speeyor's noble fur coat. Terribly soft.

4036157.name: Dinodon Ribs
4036157.desc: The ribs of a Dinodon. Its chewy texture can't be beat.

4036158.name: Angelic Buster Figurine
4036158.desc: An Angelic Buster Figurine that's rare because it's hand-stamped.

4036159.name: Eurenth's Letter
4036159.desc: A letter from Eurenth that contains information about the Central Region.

4036160.name: Dinogoth Shoulder Meat
4036160.desc: Meat from a Dinogoth's shoulder. Popular item for army supplies.

4036161.name: Hunter's Arena EXP Increase
4036161.desc: You gain a powerful EXP increase buff when you hunt monsters in the Hunter's Arena.

4036162.name: Mechanical Parts
4036162.desc: A big nail that used to be stuck on a Mutant Hedgehog's body. It could be useful for modding machines.

4036163.name: Grossular Shard
4036163.desc: A small and shiny crystal shard you can get from a Green Grossular.

4036164.name: Amethyst Shard
4036164.desc: A small and shiny crystal shard you can get from a Purple Amethyst.

4036165.name: Dean's Bag
4036165.desc: Dean's bag. It is full of useless junk.

4036166.name: Dean's Notebook
4036166.desc: A notebook's never been used. Dean's name is written crookedly on the back cover.

4036167.name: Pyrope Shard
4036167.desc: A small and shiny crystal shard you can get from a Fire Pyrope.

4036168.name: Obsidian Shard
4036168.desc: A small and shiny crystal shard you can get from a Dark Obsidian.

4036169.name: Gold Shard
4036169.desc: A hefty piece of shiny metal. It could be useful for making mechanical parts.

4036170.name: Vinegold Shard
4036170.desc: A hefty piece of shiny metal. The surface is covered in vines because it was buried in the forest for a long time.

4036171.name: Larimar Shard
4036171.desc: A small and shiny crystal shard you can get from a Blue Larimar.

4036172.name: Gravi Stonegar Magic Stone
4036172.desc: A stone that exudes magical energy. Obtained from Gravi Stonegar.

4036311.desc: A strange red light flickers when you shake it.

4036312.name: Jean's Gift
4036312.desc: Beautiful, but somehow it looks dangerous.

4036315.name: Flutterbuzz Powder
4036315.desc: A fine, glittering powder found on Flutterbuzz monsters in Fox Forest.

4036316.name: Pom Puff Leaf
4036316.desc: A soft, pulpy leaf found on Pom Puff Bush monsters in Fox Forest.

4036320.name: Grow-a-Buncha-Bunch Fertilizer
4036320.desc: Maru's extra special, extra smelly, nutty fertilizer.

4036321.name: Pilfered Jewelry Box
4036321.desc: A box of expensive jewelry belonging to a guest at the Snowdrift Lodge that was pilfered by a Thief Crow. Leave it with the hotel employee to return to its rightful owner.

4036322.name: Intact Battery
4036322.desc: A battery that can be obtained from Aspire Guard Robots. It's intact and can be used right away.

4036323.name: Broken Battery
4036323.desc: A battery that can be obtained from Aspire Guard Robots. However, it's useless, since it's severely damaged.

4036324.name: Aspire Engineer Shield
4036324.desc: An Engineer Shield designed to protect the user from hazardous conditions in Aspire. It  prevents industrial accidents caused by waste compressors, bio-blocking lasers, and bio-blocking gaseous matter. The number of times it activates depends on how many you have. Each activation deducts one.

4036325.name: Wondroid Emergency Repair Kit
4036325.desc: An emergency kit used to repair broken and damaged Wondroids. It's not advisable to use it on humans.

4036326.name: Data Connector
4036326.desc: You can access Adam and Eve's memories through the Data Connector.

4036327.name: Memory Sliver
4036327.desc: A small fragment from a shattered memory. The hint of a story is just barely visible inside. Gathering more fragments may make it easier to see.

4036328.name: Memory Glass
4036328.desc: A complete memory collected from Morass. Someone's story is clearly reflected within the depths of the glass.

4036329.name: Glittering Powder
4036329.desc: The glittery, powdered form of a beautiful gem that is the envy of all who look at it.

4036330.name: Anti-magic Stone Fragment
4036330.desc: A fragment of the Anti-Magic Stone that caused a horrific accident in Trueffet years ago. Even a small piece may cause tremendous damage.

4036331.name: Stolen Fruit
4036331.desc: A juicy-looking piece of fruit the bullies stole from the Big Apple Fruit shop. It really does look tasty.

4036332.name: Shadow's Core
4036332.desc: The resulting core from the strange shadow after it's been dematerialized. It still exudes an ominous black energy.

4036333.name: Tasty Seafood
4036333.desc: A piece of seafood found on Xenoroid Echo. Take it to Chef Michelin to turn it into a scrumptious dish! Don't tell him where the ingredient is from, though.

4036334.name: Experiment Remnants
4036334.desc: This is the by-product of an experiment that has gone horribly wrong. Maybe you can find a way to use it to defend the lab better.

4036335.name: Broken Shaft
4036335.desc: The shaft of a hammer that belonged to a Thralled Warhammer Knight. The knight's soul trapped within gives off an imposing energy.

4036336.name: Broken Bow
4036336.desc: A broken bow that belonged to a Thralled Archer. The knight's soul trapped within gives off a threatening energy.

4036340.desc: After enhancement, the 8-Blessing Charm loses its power and must be restored somehow.

4036341.name: Moonlight Mushroom Powder
4036341.desc: This powdered mushroom glows in the dark. Boiling it down will create a sedetive with a bitter flavor.

4036342.name: Peanut
4036342.desc: Munch, munch! Peanuts are so great.

4036343.name: Thorn Tree Sap
4036343.desc: It may be full of nutrients, but it takes a lot of work to make it palatable.

4036344.name: Dried Tree Husk
4036344.desc: Why are you carrying around bits of tree? You must be positively barking!

4036345.name: Tough Meat
4036345.desc: For the sake of your teeth, this should only be chewed in dire emergencies.

4036346.name: Crumbled Rock
4036346.desc: It's the very latest and greatest in rock-based technology!

4036347.name: Crushed Crystal
4036347.desc: It's the prettiest, sparkliest powder you've ever seen!

4036348.name: Decent Crystal
4036348.desc: Its quality is just good enough that it could be useful for something.

4036349.name: Exploding Eyeball
4036349.desc: Keep an eye out for this disgusting pyrotechnic wonder!

4036350.name: Soft Scrap Iron
4036350.desc: It's a decent chunk of leftover iron from a blacksmithing project.

4036351.name: Wiggling Tail
4036351.desc: This squiggly, wiggly tail actually looks kinda gross...

4036352.name: Meat for Storage
4036352.desc: It's decent quality meat that's been prepped and readied for long-term storage.

4036361.name: Shimmering Star

4036363.name: Captured Monster Card

4036370.name: Sturdy Piece of Wood

4036378.name: Shrelephant Meat

4280000.name: Gold Box
4280000.desc: A gold treasure chest dropped by a monster. This can be opened with the Gold Master Key available at the Cash Shop. If you already have the Master Key, just double-click the box to open it.

4280001.name: Silver Box
4280001.desc: A silver treasure chest dropped by a monster. This can be opened with the Silver Master Key available at the Cash Shop. If you already have the Master Key, just double-click the box to open it.

4280002.name: Premium Gold Box
4280002.desc: A gold treasure chest dropped by a monster. This can be opened with the Premium Gold Master Key available at the Cash Shop. If you already have the Premium Gold Master Key, just double-click the box to open it.

4280003.name: Premium Silver Box
4280003.desc: A silver treasure chest dropped by a monster. This can be opened with the Premium Silver Master Key available at the Cash Shop. If you already have the Premium Silver Master Key, just double-click the box to open it.

4280011.name: Maplenogi Gold Lock
4280011.desc: A Gold Lock dropped from a monster. You can open it by double-clicking if you have a Maplenogi Gold Key.

4280012.name: Maplenogi Silver Lock
4280012.desc: A Silver Lock dropped from a monster. You can open it by double-clicking if you have a Maplenogi Silver Key.

4290000.name: Golden Chicken Effect
4290000.desc: Golden Chicken Effect was given as a reward for helping Lazy Daisy. You can turn it ON/OFF by double-clicking the icon or using the key configuration menu to assign a shortcut key.

4290001.name: Bummer Effect
4290001.desc: This effect is for people who helped Lazy Daisy but failed to hatch the egg. You can turn it ON/OFF by double-clicking the icon or using the key configuration menu to assign a shortcut key.

4300000.name: New Year's Card (Send)
4300000.desc: A beautiful card with season's greetings.

4301000.name: New Year's Card (Receive)
4301000.desc: A beautiful card with season's greetings. Double click on it to read!

4310001.name: Icy Guitar Pick
4310001.desc: An icy blue guitar pick that will be exchanged when Inkwell returns.

4310002.name: 6th Anniversary Silver Coin
4310002.desc: A silver coin created to commemorate MapleStory's 6th Anniversary. It's only circulated during the 6th Anniversary period and has variety of uses.

4310003.name: 6th Anniversary Insignia
4310003.desc: A one of a kind, untradable item received by a player for taking over a town during a Cake or Pie invasion or from #cNPC Pie Lord Tiara or Cake Boss Daniel# after participating in a Cake or Pie invasion.

4310004.name: OSSS Medal
4310004.desc: A medal issued by the OSSS. It can be used to purchase various core cells from Senior Researcher Jett.

4310007.name: Icy Guitar Pick
4310007.desc: An icy blue pick used for playing the guitar. You can take it to Mrs. Bo to purchase a special item.

4310008.name: Moonlight Coin
4310008.desc: A coin engraved with a full moon.

4310009.name: Noble Lion King Medal
4310009.desc: A medal containing Lion King's special power. It shines with a weak silver glow, as it hasn't been purified completely.

4310010.name: Royal Lion King Medal
4310010.desc: A medal containing Lion King's special power. It shines with a bright gold glow, as it has been purified completely.

4310011.name: Christmas Snow Crystal
4310011.desc: Can be used to purchase items from Fur Puff near White Christmas Hill.

4310012.name: Golden Snow Crystal
4310012.desc: Can be used to purchase rare items from Fur White near White Christmas Hill.

4310013.name: Sol Gong Doll for Christmas
4310013.desc: A very cute rag doll with Santa hat which resembles Sol Gong. Take it to Sol Gong in Dojo for an amazing Christmas present.

4310014.name: Snowdrop Coin
4310014.desc: A coin-shaped snowdrop. You can purchase items from Inkwell with these coins.

4310015.name: Gallant Emblem
4310015.desc: An emblem gifted by the god of war. An unknown power radiates from it.

4310016.name: Red Button
4310016.desc: A red button. These can be used to purchase items from Inkwell.

4310018.name: Crusader Coin
4310018.desc: The currency used within the Silent Crusade. Available supplies are determined by your rank.

4310019.name: Tourist Memorial Coin
4310019.desc: A memorial coin distributed to the tourists of Maple World. Collecting these coins will come in handy later on.

4310020.name: Monster Park Commemorative Coin
4310020.desc: A special coin to commemorate the Monster Park. Take it to Laku at the Monster Park to trade it for a special item.

4310021.name: Dolphin Island Commemorative Coin
4310021.desc: A commemorative coin given to visitors to Dolphin Island. The back of the coin features Pason's signature.\n#cGather up 4 and bring them to Pason to trade them for a Traveling Pouch.#

4310022.name: Cherry Blossom Commemorative Coin
4310022.desc: A commemorative coin given to those who visit the cherry blossoms. The back of the coin features the signature of Chief Stan.\n#cGather up 4 and bring them to Chief Stan to trade them for a Traveling Pouch.#

4310023.name: Luck Coin
4310023.desc: Gather enough Luck Coin and exchange it for rewards from #cNPC Inkwell#.

4310024.name: Treasure Hunt 'You Lose' Note
4310024.desc: A treasure hunt note featuring a picture of a bomb. That probably means it's no good.\n#cGather up the 'You Lose' notes and bring them to Hooper, the merchant, to trade them for food items.#

4310025.name: 7th Anniversary Coin
4310025.desc: A coin to commemorate MapleStory's 7th Anniversary. You can only find these during the 7th Anniversary celebration. You can use them to buy Joy Bird Feathers, which Inkwell can then use to upgrade Maple Beryl equipment into Crimson Maple equipment.

4310027.name: Legends Awards Coin
4310027.desc: A coin used during the Legends Awards. Can be used to purchase various useful items in the Legends Shop.

4310028.name: Legends Maple Coin
4310028.desc: A special currency used during the Legends event. You can use it from the Maple Tab in the Legends Shop.

4310029.name: Crusader Coins
4310029.desc: A special coin used to buy Silent Crusade items.

4310030.name: Homecoming Coin
4310030.desc: A special sporty coin that can be exchanged for equipment and scrolls from Inkwell.

4310031.name: Legends Awards Coin
4310031.desc: A coin that can be obtained by participating in various Maple Award events. You can trade it for items at the Award Shop by opening the UI on the left side of the screen.

4310034.name: Renegades Coin
4310034.desc: A coin used during the Renegades Festival. Can be used to purchase various useful items in the Renegades Shop.

4310036.name: Conqueror's Coin
4310036.desc: Coin obtained by clearing Fight for Azwan. Used to purchase rare Azwan items.

4310037.name: Clover Coin
4310037.desc: You can trade it with NPC Rechanuni who is infront of PMD entrance for valuable items which are obtainable only in Premium Dungeon.

4310038.name: Emperor's Coin
4310038.desc: Coin obtained by clearing the Fight for Azwan on Hard Mode. Used to purchase rare Azwan items.

4310043.name: Alien Coin
4310043.desc: Even aliens love to have a little coin in their pockets! Bring it to Pico in NLC to exchange for a Nebulite.

4310048.name: 8th Anniversary Coin
4310048.desc: Coin released in celebration of 8th Maple Anniversary. Only used during 8th Anniversary, this can be used to purchase Maple armors and other special items from Inkwell.

4310050.name: Old Maple Coin
4310050.desc: Use them to buy special items from Old Maple Event Shop.

4310051.name: Purified Spirit Stone
4310051.desc: This is one squeaky-clean Spirit Stone. Take it to the supply soldier in Momijigaoka.

4310054.name: Sengoku Coin
4310054.desc: A coin from the Sengoku Festival. Use it to purchase items from the Sengoku Store during the event.

4310055.name: Purified Spirit Stone
4310055.desc: A Spirit Stone purified by Tsuchimikado Haruaki. Take it to the supply soldier in Momijigaoka to receive the Spirit of the Soul.

4310057.name: Tempest Coin
4310057.desc: Newly minted to celebrate the Tempest Festival. Allows you to purchase various limited-time items during the festival.

4310058.name: Magnus Coin
4310058.desc: A coin that you obtained for defeating Magnus. Talk to Shadow Merchant Mayal to trade it in.

4310059.name: Shadow Merchant Coin
4310059.desc: A secret coin obtained for helping the Shadow Merchant Crew. Talk to Shadow Merchant Mayal to trade it in.

4310060.name: Evolving Coin
4310060.desc: Turn this in to Vendor-C2 in the Evolution Lab for Cores, Equipment, and Scrolls.

4310061.name: 2014 Homecoming Coin
4310061.desc: Turn this in to Wonky in the Event Hall for sports equipment and scrolls.

4310062.name: Masked Gentleman Coin
4310062.desc: This silver coin is one of the Masked Gentleman's family heirlooms. Take it back to him to trade for various items.

4310063.name: Step Pop Coin
4310063.desc: Turn this in to NPC Lux in town for valuable items. Lux's items change every 2 hours.\nVisit the Free Market Entrance in Channel 1 to find Lux.

4310064.name: Yggdrasil Rune
4310064.desc: An ancient stone engraved with Yggdrasil's rune. Take it to the merchant in the Root Abyss to trade for a Sealed Box.

4310065.name: Chaos Yggdrasil Rune
4310065.desc: An ancient stone engraved with Chaos Yggdrasil's rune. Take it to the merchant in the Root Abyss to trade for a Sealed Box.

4310066.name: Unleashed Coins
4310066.desc: A coin that lets you buy various scrolls, equipment, and Mastery Books from the Solar Power Coin Shop.

4310067.name: PC Cafe Coin
4310067.desc: 프리미엄 PC방에서만 획득 가능한 코인 아이템이다. 린에게서 주문서, 장신구 등으로 교환할 수 있다.

4310069.name: Monster Life Coin
4310069.desc: Coin purchased with Monster Life Warus. Used to purchase goods from Jimmy-Jack.

4310070.name: New Year's Yut Coin
4310070.desc: A coin that lets you buy various scrolls, equipment, and Mastery Books from the New Year's Coin Shop.

4310071.name: New Year's Kite Coin
4310071.desc: A coin that lets you buy various scrolls and equipment from the New Year's Coin Shop.

4310075.name: Oda Coin
4310075.desc: Take this to Goemon to exchange for totems.

4310079.name: 9th Anniversary Coins
4310079.desc: Coin released in celebration of 9th Maple Anniversary. Only used during 9th Anniversary, this can be used to purchase Maple armors and other special items from Inkwell.

4310080.name: 9th Anniversary Maple Leaf
4310080.desc: A beautiful maple leaf. #cYou can trade it for 9th Anniversary Coins from Inkwell, but only during the event period.#

4310081.name: OSSS Coin
4310081.desc: A medal coin issued by the OSSS. It can be used to purchase various core cells from Senior Researcher Jett.

4310084.name: Frontier Coin
4310084.desc: You can take it to Inkwell to purchase a Frontier special item.

4310085.name: Time Coin
4310085.desc: A coin imbued with the power of time.

4310086.name: Job Advancement Coin
4310086.desc: This coin is required for Open Advancement, which is only available for Explorers, excluding Jett.

4310088.name: RED Coin
4310088.desc: A red coin with the letters RED imprinted on it. #cYou can use it to buy items at the RED Shop.#

4310091.name: Anheim Coin
4310091.desc: A coin minted by the Anheim Magic School. Anheim Coins can be exchanged for anti-magic and other useful items.

4310092.name: Kritias Commemorative Coin
4310092.desc: A coin minted by the Kritias Government. It has a very high value.

4310095.name: Silver Farm Coin
4310095.desc: A silver coin only usable in the goose farm. You can use them when purchasing special items at the goose farm. Talk to the farm owner.

4310096.name: SAO Coin
4310096.desc: Coins required to enter the Sword Art Online Dungeon. NerveGear is used to travel to different worlds.

4310099.name: Spring Bunny Coin
4310099.desc: Take these coins to the Spring Bunny Salesman in the Event Hall to get rare items. Can only be used during the Spring Event period.

4310100.name: Commerci Denaro
4310100.desc: A coin used exclusively by the traders of Commerci.

4310101.name: Black Friday Coin
4310101.desc: A coin to celebrate the funnest shopping day of all... Black Friday!

4310102.name: Mustache Comb
4310102.desc: Carlton the mustache researcher is looking for this comb. You can trade this for a special item at Carlton's Mustache Lab.

4310103.name: Mustache Scissors
4310103.desc: Carlton the mustache researcher is looking for these scissors. You can trade them for a special item at Carlton's Mustache Lab.

4310104.name: RP Coin
4310104.desc: It can be exchanged for items from Paul.

4310105.name: Model Student Candy
4310105.desc: A reward that Mr. Schrodinger only gives to exemplary students. You can use the Lockers at Maple Leaf High with these candies.

4310108.name: Nut Coin
4310108.desc: These coins are the future! Their value can only go up! Use them buy special items from Roasty the Nut Merchant.

4310110.name: 9th Anniversary Coin
4310110.desc: Collect these coins during the 9th anniversary event and use them to purchase all sorts of neat items from the 9th Anniversary Coin Shop.\r\n

4310113.name: Carrot Coin
4310113.desc: A coin featuring a fresh-looking carrot mark. Use them buy special items from Roasty the Nut Merchant.

4310119.name: 10th Anniversary Coin
4310119.desc: A coin released to mark the 10th Maple Anniversary. Only used during the 10th Anniversary, this can be used to purchase special items.

4310124.name: Hugh Head's Gold Needle
4310124.desc: A gold needle from Hugh Head. You can trade it to him for new uniforms.

4310125.name: Hugh Head's Silver Needle
4310125.desc: A silver needle from Hugh Head. You can trade it to him for new uniforms.

4310126.name: Hot Summer Coin
4310126.desc: These coins are the future! Their value can only go up! Use them to buy special items from Roasty's Hot Summer Shop.

4310129.name: Winter Limited Coin
4310129.desc: A coin that lets you buy various scrolls, damage skins, and chairs from the Winter Limited Coin Shop.

4310136.name: Old Maple Coin(2)
4310136.desc: Use them to buy special items from Old Maple Event Shop.

4310144.name: Attack on Titan Reward Stamp
4310144.desc: You can exchange these stamps for rewards at the Attack on Titan Rewards Shop.

4310148.name: Star World Coin
4310148.desc: This is Star World's primary currency. Use it to buy items from the Star World Coin Shop.

4310149.name: Game Machine Coin
4310149.desc: Put these coins into the game machine to play a game.

4310150.name: Reward Coin
4310150.desc: You can exchange these coins for rewards.

4310153.name: FIREPOWER Coin
4310153.desc: This coin is available during the FIREPOWER event. It can be used to purchase various items from the Coin Commissary, Korean Folk Town, and more.

4310154.name: FIREPOWER SP Coin
4310154.desc: This coin is #ca very special one# from the FIREPOWER event. It can be used to purchase exclusive items from Agent Burns.

4310155.name: Valentine Heart
4310155.desc: A sweet heart for Valentine's Day.

4310156.name: AbsoLab Coin
4310156.desc: Exchange these coins for official AbsoLab equipment.

4310163.name: 11th Anniversary Coin
4310163.desc: A coin released to mark the 11th Maple Anniversary. Only used during the 11th Anniversary, this can be used to purchase special items.

4310166.name: 10-Year Token
4310166.desc: Collect these and bring them to the Artifact Keeper at the Event Hall to get popular rewards from past events!

4310167.name: Beefy Coin
4310167.desc: Used to purchase materials for Beefy's Kitchen. You can only use them during the event period, and they will vanish afterward.

4310172.name: Pepe Coin
4310172.desc: Purchase special items from Pepe at the 2015 Summer Main Town and Monster Treasure Town.

4310175.name: Star M Coin
4310175.desc:
#cEvent Period: 
Until TKTKTK#

#cStar M Coin Shop Available:
Until TKTKTK#

A special coin that can be acquired from Star Planet M. Purchase various items during the event period.

4310177.name: Yu Garden Coin
4310177.desc: A coin that can only be used in Yu Garden. You can exchange it for items from the Yu Garden or Black Market merchants.

4310180.name: Madhouse Coin
4310180.desc: Accepted at all major vending machines in the hospital.

4310181.name: 2016 Homecoming Coin
4310181.desc: Turn this in to Wonky in the Event Hall for sports equipment and scrolls.

4310184.name: World Traveler Coin
4310184.desc: A coin from the year 2015! Travel the world to scrounge these up, and use them to purchase special items from the Coin Shop.

4310185.name: 2016 Rice Cake Festival Coin
4310185.desc: A coin printed in the year 2016! They mark the celebration of the rice festival. Use them to purchase special items from the Coin Shop.

4310186.name: Alishan Coin
4310186.desc: A coin that can be found on Alishan, and is only accepted there. Take it to #cLunch Vendor# and use it to purchase all kinds of items.

4310188.name: Junk Food Coin
4310188.desc: Bring these to the Junk Food Merchant to purchase event items.

4310189.name: Reboot Coin
4310189.desc: A coin that marks the opening of the Reboot Server. Use it to purchase special items at the Reboot Coin Shop.

4310194.name: Avatar Box Stamp
4310194.desc: A stamp earned by recycling items received from the Avatar Random Box!\nYou can exchange them at the Avatar Random Box Stamp Shop, by the Free Market Entrance!

4310195.name: Heroes Coin
4310195.desc: This coin is available during the summer event. It can be used to purchase various items from the Heroes Coin Shop.

4310198.name: Rice Drop Soup Coin
4310198.desc: A big coin engraved with the image of a delicious-looking rice drop soup. It can be traded to Pink Mong for various items.

4310199.name: Stigma Coin
4310199.desc: Stigma coin that can be traded for AbsoLab equipment. Talk to the Demon Supplier in Deserted Camp.

4310201.name: Broken Gold Fragment
4310201.desc: A fragment broken off of a golden statue. You can exchange it for items from Lil' Murgoth.

4310202.name: Zero-Point Energy Module
4310202.desc: A device capable of harvesting ambient energy. \r\nMerona got lost inside the Cube searching for this.

4310203.name: Clone DNA
4310203.desc: A DNA sample  that can be collected from PULSAR's clones.\r\nIt's been modified by PULSAR's biotechnology.\r\nYou can trade this with the Space Detective wandering around inside the Cube.

4310204.name: PULSAR Medallion
4310204.desc: A token that proves you belong to PULSAR.\r\nIt smells like icky pirate, but it could be valuable to somebody.

4310205.name: PULSAR Jewel
4310205.desc: A device to awaken mystical creatures and control their minds.\r\nBigby in the Hyperspace Cube is collecting this for unknown reasons.

4310206.name: 12th Anniversary Coin
4310206.desc: A limited-edition coin released to mark MapleStory's 12th Anniversary. It can be used during the 12th Anniversary to purchase special items.

4310209.name: Aqua Bucks
4310209.desc: A currency used during the Water Wars event. Used coin to purchase various Hydroblaster Skills and items from each team's Supply NPC.

4310210.name: V Coin
4310210.desc: A summer event coin that has a clear V mark. Take it to Wave to trade it for a special item.

4310211.name: Unity Heart
4310211.desc: 클라이언트 변경으로 소실되거나 변경되는 컨텐츠/시스템애 대한 보상으로 지급되는 코인이다.\r\n자유시장에 있는 Unity Shop에서 사용할 수 있다.

4310212.name: MMF Coin
4310212.desc: A coin commemorating the Maple Music Festival! Use them to purchase special items from the Coin Shop.

4310213.name: M-Force Go!
4310213.desc: Grants a chance for M-Forcers to deal a finishing blow. Drops 5,000 bonus mesos.

4310214.name: Ultra Beam
4310214.desc: Places a Revolving Cannon designed by Dr. Kim. Drops 10,000 bonus mesos when the enemy is defeated.

4310215.name: Mesotron-X
4310215.desc: Summons the giant robot Mesotron-X, which fires lasers in all directions every time you press the skill button. Drops 20,000 bonus mesos when the enemy is defeated.

4310216.name: AbsoLab Essence
4310216.desc: Contains the essence of AbsoLab equipment. Used to upgrade Lapis/Lazuli for Zero.

4310217.name: Arcane Umbra Essence
4310217.desc: Contains the essence of Arcane Umbra equipment. Used to upgrade Lapis/Lazuli for Zero.

4310218.name: Phantasma Coin
4310218.desc: Exchange these Phantasma coins for official Arcane Umbra equipment.

4310221.name: Persimmon Coin
4310221.desc: A fall event coin that depicts a delicious persimmon. Bring it to Mommy Moon Bunny to exchange it for something special.

4310224.name: BFF Coin
4310224.desc: The premium currency used by the BFF Finder app. You can exchange it for various special items at the BFF Coin Shop!

4310225.name: Override Coin
4310225.desc: It's a shiny Override Event Coin! You can trade it for various special items at the #cOverride Coin Shop# run by Yeti.

4310226.name: New Year's Coin
4310226.desc: Exchangable for various items in Ms. Song's Shop.

4310227.name: Dream Coin
4310227.desc: A coin you received for taking on Dream Defender. You can trade it for rewards with Mr. Flopsy, the Dreamweaver.

4310228.name: Magpie Coin
4310228.desc: It's a Magpie Coin depicting an adorable magpie. You can exchange it for various and special items at the #New Year's Coin Shop# run by Magnus the Magpie.

4310229.name: Legion Coin
4310229.desc: A coin acquired with your Legion's hard work and cooperation.\r\nYou can exchange it for various items or use it to increase your Legion rank at #cDame Appropriation and Squire Pancho in major towns#.

4310230.name: Aspire Commemorative Coin
4310230.desc: A commemorative coin issued by Aspire. You can trade it to #cAlec# in exchange for various items.

4310232.name: Dragon Boat Festival Coin
4310232.desc: Obtained by participating in the Mini-game Station event. Collect them and exchange them for exclusive event-only items!

4310235.name: Spirit Coin
4310235.desc: A coin earned by rescuing a Rock Spirit in Spirit Savior. You can exchange them for Arcane Symbols from the the <Escaped Rock Spirit> NPC.

4310237.name: Nova Coin
4310237.desc: It's a Nova Event Coin! You can redeem it for special items at the #cNova Coin Shop#, run by Manoff.

4310238.name: Absolute Taste Coin
4310238.desc: A coin earned in the Absolute Taste event. You can trade it for various items from the Spoon 'n' Pantry shop NPC.

4310241.name: Pop Coin
4310241.desc: A Pop Coin obtained for participating in the Maple Film Festival. It can be exchanged for special items in Ring Master Orchid's #cKing of the Rings Coin Shop.#

4310242.name: Snowdrift Lodge Coin
4310242.desc: A currency required for the use of the Snowdrift Lodge's services and facilities. Visit an employee in the lodge's lobby to make use of these services.

4310243.name: Lab Server Coin
4310243.desc: A coin used only on the Lab Server. Can be used to purchase many useful items from the Lab Server Shop.

4310244.name: Ghost Coin
4310244.desc: Trade this in for special items like the Halloween-themed items at the #cGhoulbuster Coin Shop# run by Hallowkitty.

4310247.name: EVA Coin
4310247.desc: It's a #cvery special coin# engraved with a special Eva mark. It can be used to purchase #cEvangelion related items# from Porter.

4310248.name: Ark Coin
4310248.desc: It's an Ark Event Coin! You can redeem it for special items at the #cArk Coin Shop#.

4310249.name: Arachno Coin
4310249.desc: Exchange these Arachno Coins for official Arcane Umbra equipment.

4310252.name: Research Coin
